packets.purpose: Margins on an item the listener already has. Same file, so every place should match by sound.

margins.text: Margin A one. I belong at thirty seconds into the Ethernet episode.
Margin A two. I belong at two minutes.
Margin A three. I belong at four minutes and thirty seconds.
Margin A four. This one has no voice, only text. I belong at seven minutes.

packets.purpose: Margins on a different episode of the same show that the listener does not have. Its first seconds match episode A.

margins.text: Margin B one. I belong at four seconds, inside the intro that both episodes share.
Margin B two. I belong at one minute into the key fob episode.
Margin B three. I belong at four minutes.

packets.purpose: Margins that claim to be on episode A but were placed by listening to episode B. No Margin should be called a sound match.

margins.text: Margin C one. I was made on the key fob episode, at four seconds, in the shared intro.
Margin C two. I was made on the key fob episode, at one minute.
Margin C three. I was made on the key fob episode, at two minutes.
Margin C four. I was made on the key fob episode, at four minutes.
